We consider the Hubbard interaction on a single site, where $n_\uparrow$ and $n_\downarrow$ are the
fermionic number operators of the two spin species, with eigenvalues $0$ and $1$.
The interaction can be rewritten in terms of the total charge,
\begin{equation}
U n_\uparrow n_\downarrow = \frac{U}{2}\left(n_\uparrow + n_\downarrow\right)^2 - \frac{U}{2}\left(n_\uparrow + n_\downarrow\right) .
\label{eq:hub}
\end{equation}
